The '''Hapan Treaty''' was a treaty between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] that regulated the alliance between the two. The treaty was signed soon after [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] became associated member of the New Republic. Hapes Consortium was to retain independence and sovereignty, and the right to maintain its own navy.<ref name="CTD" />
